v1_rule: Implement only methods with v1_status "in_scope". "deferred" entries stay here as reference and are not v1 tools.
quota_note: Two counters: search.list spends search (default 100/day). videos.list, channels.list, playlists.list, and playlistItems.list spend non_search (default 10000/day). A call spends only one counter. Prefer videos.list / playlistItems.list over search when you already have IDs.
